name: Snowline: Ski Resort Builder
subtitle: Draw trails. Watch them ski.
promotionalText: Draw trails and lifts on a tiny mountain and watch hundreds of skiers bring it to life. One price. No ads. No in-app purchases.
description:
A little mountain. A thousand possibilities.

Snowline is a calm, strategic ski-resort game. Draw trails and lifts on a miniature mountain, then watch hundreds of tiny skiers bring it to life. They arrive with different abilities, queue for your lifts, pick their runs, react to the snow and the weather, and leave happy or frustrated. Every run tells you why.

THE TERRAIN DECIDES
Every mountain is generated fresh. A trail's difficulty comes from the real slope it crosses, so a gentle beginner run and a steep expert line are found in the ground, not chosen from a menu. Trails are marked the way skiers expect: green circle, blue square, black diamond and double diamond.

LIFTS ARE THE BOTTLENECK
Trails carry skiers down; lifts carry them back up. Choose between a surface tow, a chairlift, a high-speed chair and a gondola, and watch the queues tell you where your resort is struggling.

WEATHER CHANGES EVERYTHING
A forecast strip shows what is coming. Snow falls, wind closes exposed lifts, and warm days soften the low runs. Plan ahead, or adapt on the fly.

FIVE WAYS TO PLAY
• Resort Run: a scored 12 to 18 minute session
• Zen Mountain: build at your own pace, with no way to fail
• Daily Mountain: the same mountain for everyone each day, with a Game Center leaderboard
• Mountain Journey: five mountains, from Alpine Dawn and Pine Valley to High Ridge, Glacier Basin and Three Peaks
• Endless Summit: play on, with no end to the run

MADE TO BE COMFORTABLE
• Original adaptive music and Core Haptics
• Trail difficulty shown by shape as well as colour, so it reads without colour vision
• Reduced motion support
• A VoiceOver summary of how your resort is doing
• Plays fully offline, on iPhone in landscape and on iPad

ONE PRICE
No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No tracking. Your saves stay on your device. Game Center achievements and leaderboards are optional and handled by Apple.
